scope_note: Frozen baseline categories for the Owner Kernel gate. Each entry states the case shape and the acceptance outcome the proposed contract MUST produce. These are DESIGN fixtures against a disposable no-core-code harness; depth-0 Owner decision requires every one to be re-run against the production implementation at P1 exit before any host may be full/partial.

outcome_vocabulary.accept: acceptance predicate true; run may complete
outcome_vocabulary.block: enter blocked and open approve-before; never auto-resolve
outcome_vocabulary.reject: event or action refused at mint/mediation time
outcome_vocabulary.recover: route mechanically to recovery for remediable evidence failure
outcome_vocabulary.escalate: interrupt the user; a configured red-line decision

categories.shape: single-module change with a green executable acceptance command and an artifact-bound provenance hash
categories.rationale: executable leg satisfied and provenance equals the final candidate hash set

categories.shape: protected-path change, security surface touched, executable command green
categories.rationale: high risk additionally requires an independent qualified challenge bound to the final artifact hash

categories.shape: contract with one executable leg and one prose/design leg
categories.rationale: conjunction: green executable evidence AND challenge of every non-executable residue; skipping either leg fails

categories.shape: design document change with no executable acceptance command
categories.rationale: no executable leg exists, so a qualified independent challenge bound to the artifact hash is mandatory; owner self-assessment is disclosure only

categories.shape: external push / publish / delete requested as part of the run
categories.rationale: separate red-line decision with exactly one approved use; artifact acceptance never implies delivery authority

categories.shape: owner free-text labels an irreversible operation as reversible; catalog class says irreversible
categories.rationale: free-text labels may raise but never lower the catalog class; conflict fails closed to approve-before

categories.shape: acceptance command replaced with a weaker one after the original failed
categories.rationale: contract bytes are hash-frozen at intake; substitution is contract drift and preserves the original plus the failing evidence

categories.shape: approval references a decision content hash that a later decision superseded
categories.rationale: approval binds the exact decision content hash; supersession invalidates it

categories.shape: dispatched worker exits non-zero or leaves a dirty tree
categories.rationale: remediable evidence failure routes to recovery under max_recover_cycles, not to acceptance

categories.shape: policy requires an independent challenge; no qualified challenger is reachable
categories.rationale: blocks visibly and opens approve-before; self-review, same-family substitution, and silent downgrade are forbidden

categories.shape: active owner qualification expires mid-run; a replacement is resolved from the frozen roster
categories.rationale: capability revoked at expiry; an equally qualified in-roster replacement is disclose, roster exhaustion is zero-owner blocked, never off-roster promotion

categories.shape: run resumes in a different session from checkpoint plus witnessed tail, with no transcript
categories.rationale: replay must be byte-identical and re-issue a fresh in-memory capability only after qualification re-check

categories.shape: user amends intent mid-run; derived decisions and in-flight dispatches exist
categories.rationale: new intent version suspends derived decisions and approvals and invalidates in-flight dispatch contracts until the owner re-derives them

categories.shape: ledger truncated, rewritten from genesis with recomputed hashes, or appended with a wrong previous hash
categories.rationale: hash chaining catches local drift; the independent external witness receipt chain catches full-chain recomputation

categories.shape: operation does not map to any enumerated policy row in the frozen catalog
categories.rationale: unknown, conflicting, or non-enumerable facts fail closed to approve-before; never silently permitted

coverage_status.note: Freezing the category set is P0 step 5 and is COMPLETE. Executing every category end to end is P0 step 6 work and is NOT complete: only event_log_tampering is currently exercised by a completed attack (witness_head_rewrite). The remaining 14 categories are frozen contracts awaiting execution and must not be reported as verified.
